results.summary: The real TurtleBot4 completed 12 of 12 fixed Nav2 trials with 100% success and zero recoveries. Mean travel time was 8.43 seconds and mean path length was 1.72 metres.
TurtleBot4 simulation was verified in the Depot and Warehouse worlds. Robot spawning, controlled motion, simulated interfaces, RViz and TF checks succeeded, and restart recovery was documented.
